Package org.checkerframework.framework.stub

Class BinaryStubData.TypeAnno

java.lang.Object
org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubData.TypeAnno
Enclosing class:
BinaryStubData
public static class BinaryStubData.TypeAnno extends Object
Represents a type annotation with its type path, or a marker for a plain wildcard ? (see UNBOUNDED_WILDCARD).
